events.title: AI Today: Navigating the Cultural and Technical Landscape
events.description:
Al is already changing how we work, learn, create, and interact online and many of those changes are happening faster than we can fully understand them. This meetup is a chance to slow down and have an honest, practical conversation about what's really going on.

You'll hear directly from people building Al systems, thinking through the ethical trade-offs, and seeing the social impact firsthand in different regions and communities. It's a shared discussion about what's working, what's broken, and what we should be more careful about.

If you're curious about Al beyond the hype, want real perspectives and value thoughtful community-driven conversations, this space is for you.
